-- Generated by clinical:generate; do not edit. No production application authorized.
-- V2-03 (TASK-044): persists the TASK-042 internal audit dispositions for the
-- frozen V2-01 shipping ranges. A disposition is NOT clinical approval: this
-- table refuses SAFE, carries no evidence, and no runtime code reads it until
-- this migration is verified and a separate task authorizes a consumer.
-- The V2-01 rows in public.clinical_ranges are never edited (they keep UNKNOWN).
-- Review seed SHA-256: __REVIEW_HASH__
-- Requires V2-01 seed SHA-256: __BASE_HASH__
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL standard_conforming_strings = on;
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public;
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(20261007, 44);
DO $review$
DECLARE
  seed jsonb := __REVIEW_PAYLOAD__;
  base record;
  saved record;
  rel text;
  actual jsonb;
  expected jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Mode-independent: whichever V2-01 mode ran (production, chain or absent),
  -- it must be the exact applied seed with no intervening catalog writes.
  IF to_regclass('clinical_archive.task041_state') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 requires the applied V2-01 clinical catalog (20261006000000)';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT base FROM clinical_archive.task041_state;
  IF base.seed_hash <> '__BASE_HASH__' OR base.status <> 'applied' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 requires V2-01 seed __BASE_HASH__ in applied state';
  END IF;
  FOREACH rel IN ARRAY ARRAY['clinical_catalog_entries','clinical_ranges'] LOOP
    EXECUTE format('LOCK TABLE public.%I IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE', rel);
    EXECUTE format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM public.%I t', rel) INTO actual;
    IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM base.after_rows->rel THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 V2-01 % changed since it was applied', rel;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF to_regclass('clinical_archive.task044_state') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT saved FROM clinical_archive.task044_state;
    IF saved.seed_hash <> '__REVIEW_HASH__' OR saved.base_seed_hash <> '__BASE_HASH__' OR saved.status <> 'applied' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 incompatible or rolled-back review state; explicit new migration required';
    END IF;
    IF to_regclass('public.clinical_range_reviews') IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 applied state without public.clinical_range_reviews';
    END IF;
    LOCK TABLE public.clinical_range_reviews IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), '[]'::jsonb) INTO actual FROM public.clinical_range_reviews t;
    IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM saved.after_rows THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 intervening writes in clinical_range_reviews';
    END IF;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.clinical_range_reviews') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 unclassifiable state: clinical_range_reviews exists without applied state';
  END IF;

  -- The seed must name exactly the frozen shipping identities, each still UNKNOWN.
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x::text), '[]'::jsonb) INTO expected FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('slug', r->>'slug', 'population', r->>'population', 'phase', r->>'phase', 'kind', r->>'kind') x
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(seed->'reviews') r
  ) s;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x::text), '[]'::jsonb) INTO actual FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('slug', slug, 'population', population, 'phase', phase, 'kind', kind) x
    FROM public.clinical_ranges WHERE candidate_id = 'shipping'
  ) s;
  IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 review seed does not match the V2-01 shipping range identities';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clinical_ranges WHERE candidate_id = 'shipping' AND review_status <> 'UNKNOWN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 V2-01 shipping review_status is no longer the frozen UNKNOWN';
  END IF;

  CREATE TABLE public.clinical_range_reviews (
    slug text NOT NULL,
    population text NOT NULL CHECK(population = 'general'),
    phase text CHECK(phase IN ('general','menstrual','follicular','ovulatory','luteal')),
    kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('lab_reference','amani_context')),
    candidate_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shipping' CHECK(candidate_id = 'shipping'),
    review_status text NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('NEEDS_CONTEXT','DISPUTED','UNKNOWN')),
    disposition_basis text NOT NULL CHECK(disposition_basis = 'task042_internal_audit'),
    CONSTRAINT clinical_range_reviews_slug_fkey FOREIGN KEY(slug) REFERENCES public.clinical_catalog_entries(slug),
    CONSTRAINT clinical_range_reviews_identity UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (slug,population,phase,kind,candidate_id)
  );
  COMMENT ON TABLE public.clinical_range_reviews IS 'TASK-042 internal audit disposition per V2-01 shipping range. Not clinical approval: SAFE is refused and no evidence is recorded. No runtime consumer is authorized by V2-03.';
  COMMENT ON COLUMN public.clinical_range_reviews.review_status IS 'Supersedes the frozen V2-01 UNKNOWN in clinical_ranges.review_status for the same identity.';
  INSERT INTO public.clinical_range_reviews
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.clinical_range_reviews, seed->'reviews');
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.clinical_range_reviews) <> jsonb_array_length(seed->'reviews') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-044 review row count mismatch';
  END IF;
  ALTER TABLE public.clinical_range_reviews ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  REVOKE ALL ON public.clinical_range_reviews FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
  GRANT SELECT ON public.clinical_range_reviews TO authenticated, service_role;
  CREATE POLICY clinical_range_reviews_read ON public.clinical_range_reviews FOR SELECT TO authenticated, service_role USING(true);

  CREATE TABLE clinical_archive.task044_state (
    singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK(singleton), seed_hash text NOT NULL, base_seed_hash text NOT NULL,
    status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('applied','rolled_back')), after_rows jsonb NOT NULL
  );
  REVOKE ALL ON clinical_archive.task044_state FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
  ALTER TABLE clinical_archive.task044_state ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), '[]'::jsonb) INTO actual FROM public.clinical_range_reviews t;
  INSERT INTO clinical_archive.task044_state(seed_hash, base_seed_hash, status, after_rows)
    VALUES('__REVIEW_HASH__', '__BASE_HASH__', 'applied', actual);
END $review$;
COMMIT;
